name: Dan Koe
description: Minimal black-and-white line art for a reel. One white dot on pure black grows into a hairline tree that splits in two at every step, the tips light up, a pulse ring and sparks go off, and one quiet lowercase line swaps to a second.
style: Minimal line art: pure black, hairline white strokes, solid white dots, one lowercase line of text; quiet and plain, no bold, no exclamation marks.
